body:
Design cleanup, theme and global web chrome (both clients).
Decisions 1-3 in the design cleanup brief: dark text on the light accent (#0B1220), dark text on
the dark-mode red (#1A0505), accent text on surfaces clears 4.5:1. Web: separate input-border
token of at least 3:1 and an accent-strong focus ring (web B4), 44px touch targets for .btn-icon,
.segmented, .chip-remove and menu links (web B2), app menu keyboard handling and focus order
(web B9), viewport-fit=cover and per-page document title (web B16), distinct "All items" glyph
from the menu ☰ (web W3). Parity tests in brandColors.test.ts / ThemeTest updated.
title: Design cleanup: theme contrast tokens and global web chrome
